title: La Ligue des Ferrailleurs
description: Assemble three expressive scrap automatons with real 3D modules, then pause, target and overload through five deterministic arena fights and a finale.
controls: Mouse/touch: assemble modules, choose starting cells and inspect units
Space: pause/resume; 1/2/3: select a friendly automaton
T: priority target; R: retreat; O: module overload
M: sound; EN/FR/ES selector in the header
credits: Designed and developed with Kimi for Kimi Games.
Original Blender models, GLB exports, interface, isometric WebGL renderer and synthesized audio created for this game.
No third-party runtime libraries or external assets.
